parameters.name: revoke

schema.description: Revoke the upstream OAuth2 grant at the provider before deleting the account. `true` deletes the account whatever the outcome, `required` keeps it unless the grant is gone

x-meta.usage:
Set this when deleting an account should also cut EmailEngine off at the provider, for example because a user asked for their data to be disconnected rather than just removed here.

It currently works for individual Gmail OAuth2 grants. Gmail Workspace service-account integrations, Outlook and non-OAuth2 accounts ignore it. The response reports the outcome under `revocation`. With `true` a failed revocation never blocks the deletion; use `required` when the account must stay until the grant is gone, so a failure can be retried without reading the token out of EmailEngine.
